content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for APEDA Associate Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 24-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for APEDA Associate (Trade) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the APEDA Associate (Trade) position is 24 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Associate (Trade) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Economics, Agri Economics, International Trade, or a related field. Additionally, a minimum of 2 years of post-master's work experience is mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Associate (Trade) position is 45 years. There are no specified minimum age limits mentioned in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Associate (Trade) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Associate (Trade) post will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 80,000 to Rs. 1,05,000.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the APEDA Associate (Trade) job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your complete bio-data and required documents to the official email address specified in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Associate (Trade) position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Associate (Trade) post will primarily involve an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this APEDA recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Associate (Trade) position is contract-based.

faq.question: Q9. What specific skills are preferred for the Associate (Trade) role?
faq.answer: Besides the educational qualifications and experience, proficiency in visualization tools like Tableau or Power BI, as well as spreadsheets and presentation suites, is preferred.
